mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.02 over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases > 1% MoM does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.04 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 2% YoY does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.03 over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.04 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 5% MoM does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.02 over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% QoQ does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 70% of instances, or if the Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.
